ideas.pitch: A real-time municipal grievance aggregator and automated action-routing platform designed for Indian smart cities.
ideas.title: NationPulse Civic Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the hackathon's overarching theme of 'Innovations Begin for a Better Nation' by targeting local governance, matching the proven civic-tech impact pattern from Catwalk.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first computer vision mobile application for Indian farmers to instantly detect crop diseases and receive region-specific fertilizer recommendations.
ideas.title: AgriVision Soil & Crop Doctor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high social impact for the Indian agricultural sector with a rock-solid, demonstrable computer vision workflow proven at previous hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and computer vision-based automated waste segregation and municipal collection route optimizer.
ideas.title: SwachhAI Smart Waste Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets urban cleanliness initiatives for Indian metropolitan areas, leveraging a proven hardware-software demo combination.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-lingual symptom checker and triage queue manager for overburdened community health centers in India.
ideas.title: MedAccess AI Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses critical healthcare infrastructure gaps in India with localized language support, highly appealing to local judges looking for practical societal utility.

ideas.pitch: A curriculum alignment and skill-gap assessment platform helping Indian engineering students benchmark their portfolios against current industry hiring demands.
ideas.title: EduBridge Skill Gap Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the massive student demographic and employability crisis in India, presenting clear metrics and actionable dashboards that resonate with university-backed hackathon judges.
